parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue but may introduce unintended behavior.

issues.description: The change limits the monotonicity check to only the dimensions that were combined, which might break existing behavior where the check was applied to all dimensions.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the fix and ensure it does not regress in the future.
